run_hydra_initialize_compose: run hydra initialize with config_path and compose a config using config_name
run_hydra_initialize_with_job_name: run hydra initialize with config_path and job_name to set a custom job name
run_hydra_initialize_config_dir: run hydra initialize_config_dir with an absolute config directory path to compose a config
run_hydra_initialize_config_dir_with_job: run hydra initialize_config_dir with config_dir and job_name to set a custom job name
test_hydra_compose_return_hydra_config: test hydra compose with return_hydra_config to assert config values and job name
